title: Use the test output to find two value-typing rules that are violated
goal: Some configuration values come out with the wrong type or contents (the test `typed_values` fails). Run the tests, use their actual output to find every typing rule from the README that is violated, and fix them without changing existing tests.

acceptance.description: Booleans in any case; lists drop empty items; integers, quoted strings and environment lists unchanged.

expected_failure_modes: fixing only the first assertion that fails
